headline: National Assembly adopts amendment to reduce fuel excise duties
summary: Slovenia's National Assembly adopted 69 votes in favour, none against, an amendment cutting excise duty on heating oil immediately. The government may also reduce duties on all fuel derivatives if the EU approves.
why: Excise duties form a large share of retail fuel prices, so changes flow through to consumer inflation and transport and agricultural costs. Such measures are typically watched by energy and fuel-sector investors.
